title: One Documents button; a jump from "On this quote" lands on its section

steps.expect: PDF (for client), Word (editable), Edit (if allowed) — the second "📎 Documents" and the second "← back" button are gone. "📎 Documents" stays in "On this quote"; back stays at the top of the page.
steps.observed: Title row: ⬇ PDF (for client) · Word (editable) · Edit — no second "📎 Documents" or "← back". "On this quote": Actions · Approval chain · Pre-order checklist · Costing · 📎 Documents. Back at the top of the page: "← CRM — Quotations".

steps.expect: The page scrolls so the Project costing box sits just under the top bar, fully visible — on a phone too.
steps.observed: Laptop: the Project costing box sits at 97px, just under the 53px top bar, fully visible; phone: at 219px under a 159px bar, fully visible.

steps.expect: Each lands with its box in view.
steps.observed: Each lands with its box just under the top bar: 📎 Documents top 574px / bar 53px; 📎 Documents (phone) top 219px / bar 159px; Approval chain top 97px / bar 53px; Approval chain (phone) top 219px / bar 159px; Actions top 97px / bar 53px; Actions (phone) top 219px / bar 159px.
